title: William E. Echeverría Tigse
text:
About
I am a PhD researcher in Economics and Finance at the University of Coimbra and the University of Minho, and a researcher at the Centre for Business and Economics Research (CeBER), University of Coimbra. I hold a PhD studentship from the Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia (FCT). My research interests are international political economy, financialisation, innovation, elite studies, dollarisation, econometrics and geometrical data analysis.
I hold an M.Sc. in Development Economics from FLACSO Ecuador, a degree in Economics and Financial Sciences Engineering from the National Polytechnic School in Quito, and a B.A. in Economics and Management from Jean Monnet University in Saint-Étienne. In Ecuador, I have worked on the assessment and quality assurance of higher education, including as an advisor to the national accreditation council (CEAACES). I have taught economics at Universidad UTE since 2024.
